Fourth round — lost 2–1 away to Everton.
Winners — beat West Ham United 2–1 in the Villa Park replay after a 1–1 draw.
Winners — beat Real Madrid 1–0 in Paris.

overview: Liverpool finished fifth in the First Division, nine points behind champions Aston Villa, but won the European Cup and League Cup under Bob Paisley. Alan Kennedy scored the only goal against Real Madrid in Paris to secure the club’s third European Cup.

The League Cup was a first for Liverpool. After drawing 1–1 with West Ham United at Wembley, they won the replay 2–1 at Villa Park through Kenny Dalglish and Alan Hansen. West Ham had also been beaten in the Charity Shield, while Everton ended Liverpool’s FA Cup run in the fourth round.

Terry McDermott finished as leading scorer with 22 competitive goals, including one in the Shield. Bruce Grobbelaar arrived from Vancouver Whitecaps and Craig Johnston from Middlesbrough during the spring, while Steve Heighway left for Minnesota Kicks. Grobbelaar’s competitive debut would follow in the next campaign.
